properties.media:imagetext:
CO OUR PATRONS
PARTIES & DINNERS with specially prepared menus may be
arranged with our maitre d'hotel.
Kindly ask the head waiter for souvenir menus ready for mailing.
THE ENTERTAINMENT AND INFORMATION DESKS are lo-
cated in the lobby, where arrangements may be made for sports
activities and motor tours.
THE QUIET RESTFUL SIXTH FLOOR SUN LOUNGE:
High
above the street, a rare view of the Broad Pacific and the Beau-
tiful Koolau Mountain Range may be had.
THE WAIALAE GOLF COURSE offers you the finest 18-hole
golf links in the Territory. Completely equipped clubhouse. Ted
Benedict, Professional. Green fees $2.00 on Mondays, Tuesdays,
Thursdays and Fridays and $2.50 on Wednesdays, Saturdays,
Sundays and Holidays.
Monthly rates quoted.
Dinner-dance
every Tuesday and Friday.
Special parties arranged.
TENNIS: The Royal Hawaiian Hotel Courts are available to
guests of the Moana
Hotel. Tennis Instruction by Phil Bagby,
Professional. Courts may be reserved and appointments for in-
struction made through the front office.
A VISIT to the pineapple cannery is interesting.
Please see
the clerk at the front desk.
A CRATE OF FRESH HAWAIIAN PINEAPPLES can be
shipped by refrigerated express anywhere in the mainland. In-
formation at the front office.
EVENTS OF THE DAY
HAWAIIAN CONCERT IN DINING ROOM
By Al Perry's Surf-riders.
... 7:15 P.M.

Room Service 25
cents each person.
Breakfast 7 to 10
Luncheon 12 to 2
Dinner 6 to 8.
Honolulu, Hawaii, U.S. A.
Sunday, December 26th, 1937
